question: Should this issue remain the broad memory-management consistency tracker while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 and the Memory MVP issues handle narrower slices, or should maintainers narrow it to one specific config/API contract such as memory mode selection?
rationale: The remaining work changes public memory config, plugin ownership, doctor migration, docs, and memory lifecycle semantics, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product/API direction.

options.title: Keep broad tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open as the umbrella until role slots, backend selection, flush/write behavior, and operator memory surfaces converge.

options.title: Narrow to role slots
options.body: Declare https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60572 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 the canonical architecture path and reduce this issue to any remaining backend/flush contract gap.

options.title: Define memory modes
options.body: Sponsor a smaller builtin-only/qmd-only/mixed configuration design, accepting that it may not solve role-slot ownership or CRUD memory semantics by itself.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the umbrella until role slots, backend selection, flush/write behavior, and operator memory surfaces converge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a durable public config/plugin API direction decision, and steipete is both the listed project decision owner and a recent memory docs/flush contributor.
